action_comparison: canonical exact action on U0 same-state bank at ALL periods; diagnostic n20 selection, formal n40 corroboration; IDs retained
clarification: User confirmed true self-consistent damping on 2026-10-07. Historical A reconstruction and common V0/V1 match A; subsequent raw V2/V3 evaluate ACTUAL damped D2/D3, not frozen undamped policies.

convergence.note: descriptive joint criteria, not a convergence theorem

effectiveness.meaning: joint evidence, not just profit; diagnostic/formal gain directions must agree; W80 paired t95 lower must exceed negative 1% of abs(U4 mean); a failed evidence threshold is not proof of no effect

future_sampling: own scenario only; no shared donor; same CRN scenario across iterations
historical_policy_alias: D1=U1; cached duplicate trace only with explicit alias and exact identity checks

interpolation.counterfactual_max_q: 2K: retained nonqueried resources plus inserted queried supply
interpolation.q: piecewise linear at integer q; endpoint constant beyond measured K
interpolation.time: piecewise linear; endpoint constant below first node

placement_rule: sum eligible CFS outbound WGT_FACTOR by hub; K3 top3; K8 one-per-hub plus top3; tie by hub ID; no fleet RNG
sample_unit: scenario seed; 40 formal independent paired scenarios per condition
scientific_scope: approximate separable resource-value policy iteration; no action correction, RL or oracle evaluation

selection.action_increase: step4 full disagreement > step2 + 0.02 in CA or W40
selection.collapse: D4-D1 mean < -5% abs(D1 mean) AND paired t95 upper < 0 in any key regime
selection.no_eligible: select among fewest failed screens using same lexicographic rule; mark exploratory selection, ineligible for claimed stabilization
selection.scope: one global alpha; equal-weight CA80/3 and W40/8; W80 safety screen
selection.table_increase: last relativeL2 > 1.10 * first nonzero relativeL2 + 1e-12 in CA or W40

state_sampling: each iteration recollect current parent-policy on-policy states; fixed seed/time/hub grid

terminal.commitments: full physical cooldown; no new controls
